name: Ditrimethylolpropane tetraacrylate
description: Ditrimethylolpropane tetraacrylate ( CAS 94108-97-1 ), commercially available as BEAMSET 730 and ARONIX M 408, is a tetrafunctional acrylate monomer used as a reactive crosslinker and diluent in UV- and EB-curable systems. Its four acrylate groups deliver high crosslink density, making it a preferred building block where hardness, chemical resistance, and fast cure response are required for industrial applications. In UV-curable coatings for plastics and metal substrates, it contributes to scratch-resistant, high-gloss surface finishes with low shrinkage. Printing ink formulators incorporate it into energy-curable inkjet inks. Flexographic inks utilize this monomer to achieve rapid cure speeds and strong adhesion to packaging substrates. In adhesive and sealant formulations, it functions as a reactive crosslinker that improves cohesive strength. It enhances solvent resistance without requiring post-cure heating. Radiation-curable resin systems for optical films and electronics coatings also use it to control network density and final film hardness. Ditrimethylolpropane tetraacrylate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. It is available in technical and industrial grades, with specifications typically aligned to UV/EB coating and ink manufacturing standards. Bulk, drum, and IBC packaging options are standard across the supply chain.
